name: Power Driller
description: The Power Driller is a high-performance tool designed for effortless drilling in wood, metal, concrete, and other surfaces. Ideal for farmers, builders, and DIY users, this durable machine offers powerful torque and variable speed control for precision work. Its ergonomic design ensures a comfortable grip and reduced fatigue during long use. Whether you’re installing fences, assembling equipment, or performing home repairs, this power driller delivers efficiency, reliability, and smooth operation every time

name: Tractor
description: A tractor is a powerful vehicle designed primarily for agricultural, construction, and hauling purposes. It is equipped with large rear wheels for maximum traction, a strong engine for pulling heavy loads, and various attachments or implements such as plows, tillers, and trailers.

name: Hoe
description: A hoe is a traditional hand tool used in agriculture and gardening for tilling soil, removing weeds, and shaping planting rows. It typically consists of a long wooden or metal handle attached to a flat metal blade set at an angle. The hoe is ideal for loosening soil, mixing fertilizers, and preparing seedbeds. It is lightweight, durable, and easy to handle, making it an essential tool for both small-scale farmers and gardeners.
